name: web_fetch
description:
Read a web page as Markdown.

Handles the shapes that are worth handling: GitHub file views are read as the
raw file rather than the surrounding application, JSON is pretty-printed, and
ordinary pages are stripped of navigation and converted to Markdown.

Reddit is refused rather than fetched — it needs an OAuth app now, and what
comes back without one is a login wall that converts to Markdown perfectly
and says nothing.

max_output.description: Bytes of content to return. Default 100000. Truncation is reported

name: web_search
description:
Search the web.

Use this when the answer is not in the repository and not in the knowledge
library: a library's current API, a provider's error codes, whether a
workaround is still needed. Follow up with `web_fetch` on the results worth
reading — the snippets are a way to choose a page, not a substitute for one.

num_results.description: How many results to return. Default 5, maximum 20

recency.description: Restrict to results from the last 'day', 'week', 'month' or 'year'. Omit for no restriction
